title: Sampling Design and Confidence Tubes for Integral Curves on Riemannian Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2611.00771v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We estimate the integral curve of an unknown vector field from noisy tangent vector field on a known compact Riemannian manifold. We consider two sampling settings: independent observations at random locations that have already been collected, and a fixed response budget that allows subsequent locations to be chosen using pilot information. Under suitable regularity assumptions, the passive kernel estimator has curve error of order $n^{-2/(d+3)}$ in probability, with sample size $n$ and manifold dimension $d$. Its functional central limit theorem has a limit characterized by a linear stochastic differential equation. For active sampling, an independent pilot directs one new batch of measurements to neighborhoods of the target curve. translated_title: 黎曼流形上积分曲线的抽样设计与置信管
translated_abstract: 我们在已知紧黎曼流形上，利用带噪声的切向量场来估计未知向量场的积分曲线。我们考虑两种抽样设置：一种是在已收集的随机位置上的独立观测，另一种是在固定响应预算下，允许利用先导信息来选择后续观测位置。在适当的正则性假设下，被动核估计量的曲线误差以概率达到 $n^{-2/(d+3)}$ 阶，其中 $n$ 为样本量，$d$ 为流形维数。其函数型中心极限定理的极限由一个线性随机微分方程刻画。对于主动抽样，一个独立的先导样本将新的一批测量引导至目标曲线的邻域。在局部化、光滑性和设计条件下，这种集中性使得期望最大曲线误差达到 $N^{-1/2}$ 阶，其中先导样本计入总响应预算 $N$。两种方法均……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在紧黎曼流形上提出了估计未知向量场积分曲线的被动与主动两种抽样方法，证明了被动核估计的曲线误差阶为 $n^{-2/(d+3)}$ 并给出由线性随机微分方程刻画的函数型中心极限定理，同时证明基于先导信息的主动抽样可将期望最大曲线误差提升至 $N^{-1/2}$ 阶，从而为构建置信管奠定基础。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes passive and active sampling methods for estimating integral curves of unknown vector fields on compact Riemannian manifolds, establishing that the passive kernel estimator achieves a curve error rate of $n^{-2/(d+3)}$ with a functional central limit theorem characterized by a linear SDE, while pilot-guided active sampling improves the expected maximum curve error to order $N^{-1/2}$, enabling the construction of confidence tubes.
